title: Individual Development Plans
manage_intro: Individual Development Plans for the people you govern — including the ones auto-created from a high-potential (blue) 9-box placement. Open a plan to review objectives, sign off, and close actions (which can lift the related skill level).
manage_empty: No development plans for your team yet. They appear here when a high-potential 9-box placement is approved or a cycle generates IDP drafts.
overdue_title: Past its end date and still active
new_intro: Start a draft IDP for one of your people. Pick the skill gaps to turn into objectives — each becomes a SMART objective plus a training action. The plan stays a draft until both you and the employee sign it off.
seed_hint: Choosing a person and creating the plan will let you seed objectives from their gaps on the next step.
no_gaps: No open skill gaps found for this person — you can still create an empty plan and add objectives manually.
seed_gaps_hint: Tick the gaps to turn into objectives (required > current). You can refine them after the plan is created.
my_empty: No individual development plan concerns you yet. An IDP is created by your manager — from a skill gap or a talent placement — then signed by both of you.
complete_open_hint: {{count}} objective(s) still open. To complete the plan anyway, give the reason — open objectives stay as they are, nothing is erased.
complete_ready_hint: All objectives are closed: the plan can be completed.
err_own_plan: You cannot close or move your own development plan.
err_forbidden: You are not authorized to manage this development plan.
err_not_active: This action is only possible on an active plan.
err_open_objectives: {{count}} objective(s) are still open: close them first, or give a reason to complete the plan anyway.
err_stale: This plan was just changed by someone else. Reload the page.
err_not_archivable: Only an active or completed plan can be archived.
err_reason_required: A reason is required to archive an active plan.
err_objective_state: An objective can only be started or marked as achieved.
err_objective_transition: This objective cannot move to that state from its current one.
actions_empty_msg: An action says what will actually be done (training, mentoring, practice). Add the first one.
objectives_empty_msg: An objective says which level to reach and by when. Add the first one.
err_not_open: An objective or an action can only be added to a draft or active plan.
done_hint: Your manager validates the action and records the level they observed. Until then, your official level does not change.
current_official: Current official level: {{level}}. A higher observed level becomes the official level.
current_unmeasured: Not assessed yet: the observed level becomes the first official level.
no_skill_evidence_only: This action targets no skill: validating it records the evidence, no level.
no_mapped_course: No course is mapped to this skill yet; any course of the catalogue can be chosen.
offline_or: Or plan a training outside the learning platform:
offline_no_lms: No learning platform is connected: plan the training with a date and a place.
objective_met_hint: Level reached: the objective can be completed
towards_role: This plan is built towards the role {{role}}: its objectives are measured against that role's levels.
obj_seed_unmeasured: Reach level {{to}} in "{{skill}}" (current level not assessed)
print_sign_note: The signatures recorded in the application remain the reference; this sheet is the copy for the one-to-one.
sign_needs_hint: Before it can be signed, the plan needs at least one action and a due date on every objective.
err_not_signable_action: This plan cannot be signed yet: add at least one action first.
err_not_signable_due: This plan cannot be signed yet: {{count}} objective(s) have no due date.
err_action_not_found: This action does not exist (any more).
err_action_reported: This action was already reported done; it is waiting for validation.
err_not_subject: Only the person the plan is for reports an action done; the manager validates it.
err_level: The observed level is a whole number from 0 to 4.
err_hours: Hours are a number from 0 to 2000.
err_training_date: A training outside the learning platform needs a date.
err_course_not_found: This course does not exist (any more).
err_proposal_employee: Only an employee proposes an action for their own development.
err_proposal_not_found: This proposal does not exist (any more).
err_decline_reason_required: Say why you decline: the person reads it.
flash_action_reported: Noted: your manager will validate this action.
flash_target_merged: The target role's objectives were added to the open plan.
propose_cta: Propose an action to my manager
propose_intro: You know what would help you progress. Propose it in one sentence: your manager accepts it into your plan, or explains why not. Without a manager, the proposal goes to HR.
propose_type_hint: Most progress comes from practice on the job, then from others (coaching, mentoring), then from courses.
propose_text_hint: 500 characters at most. Do not write anyone else's name.
propose_mine_none: You have not proposed any action yet.
